# Windows' locale names with a sort name that ICU itself has a collation for (design item 12), each by two published
# tables, and no name without both: Microsoft's table of its locale names by locale id, whose sort names stand under
# their sort ids (the .NET runtime's src/libraries/System.Private.CoreLib/src/System/Globalization/IcuLocaleData.cs,
# read at github.com/dotnet/runtime, commit 6e51f762bc4c98ea90ae6ca21c4e220b4b2e7a5c; [MS-LCID]'s Appendix A has
# es-ES_tradnl's id too), and ICU's own table from a Windows locale id to its locale, the vendored
# third_party/icu/common/locmap.cpp. The tag is that locale as ICU's uloc_toLanguageTag writes it. Every other sort
# name is unknown beside its tag.
# name
de-DE_phoneb
es-ES_tradnl
zh-CN_stroke
